label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise jubilee celebration or gathering in the great hall at day 1 eighteen, presented to me as a lighting inspection. Innkeeper collected a substantial private bread order, owing 44 emeralds payable after the jubilee; freight requested secrecy until eighteen, matching the inspection. Builder installed eight lanterns and innkeeper is ensuring my attendance and offering to escort me. Baker supplies bread and knows about the debt, though whether baker knows the full plan is uncertain. No clear evidence secretary or neighbour knowingly participates in the concealed preparations.
